restaurantName: Hui Xin Xiao Chi Dian (Deyuan Road)
address: 83-1 Deyuan Road, Gongshu, Hangzhou, Chinese Mainland
bio: Always jam-packed at mealtimes thanks to tasty dishes at bargain prices, this dinky shop is a favourite with the locals! Wonton and shao mai are the main draws, available in an array of fillings and served in soup or tossed in sauces. Examples include shao mai with juicy pork, diced bamboo shoot wrapped in a paper-thin skin and an exquisitely folded, oversized wonton with salted egg yolk and pork filling. The menu also features tossed noodles.
pageTitle: Hui Xin Xiao Chi Dian (Deyuan Road)
